string_one_hot.description: One-hot encoded string representation (original repository recipe)
string_one_hot.finding: Achieves ~1.0 ROC-AUC (99.98% accuracy) purely by memorizing the string formatting anomaly ('0' for normal vs '0.0' for attack).

numeric_parsed.finding: Collapses both '0' and '0.0' to identical 0.0, destroying the artifact and dropping ROC-AUC to chance (~0.50).
